order_warnings: rule tech_note_prefix: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule tech_note_prefix: branches 1 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule tech_note_prefix: branches 2 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule publication_slug_or_version: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule identifier: branches 1 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)

source:
# Port of lib/pubid/adobe/parser.rb: tech notes (Adobe TN 5014, legacy
# "Adobe Technical Note #5014", ATN5014, bare 5014) and publications
# (adobe-glyph-list, adobe-japan1-7 with the version split tried first).

grammar PubidAdobe version "0.1.0" {
  tech_note_tn_prefix = "Adobe" space "TN" [space]
  tech_note_long_prefix = "Adobe" space "Technical" space "Note" [[space] ["#"] [space]]
  tech_note_atn_prefix = "ATN" [space]
  tech_note_prefix = tech_note_tn_prefix / tech_note_long_prefix / tech_note_atn_prefix
  tech_note = (tech_note_prefix 1*digit as number [(dot 1*slug_char as slug)]) as tech_note
  bare_number = 1*digit as tech_note_bare
  slug_segment = 1*lower1 *lowerd
  slug_inner = (slug_segment *(dash slug_segment)) as slug
  publication_with_version = ((slug_inner as slug) dash 1*digit as version) as publication_version
  publication_slug_or_version = publication_with_version / slug_inner
  publication = ["Adobe Publication "] publication_slug_or_version
  identifier = tech_note / bare_number / publication
  slug_char = %x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / %x5F
  lower1 = %x61-7A
  lowerd = %x61-7A / %x30-39
  digit = %x30-39
  space = " "
  dot = "."
  dash = "-"
  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "Adobe TN 15"
    accept "ATN 30"
    accept "Adobe Technical Note #12"
    reject "###"
  }
}
